thread:
Jamie: Quick checkpoint — schema-rollout (v2) milestone is tomorrow EOD. Owners: @santiago @marta @kevin please confirm blockers, canary plan, and SDK status.
Santiago: We're green on the runtime side for header parity. Need one more perf bench on 8k seqs (running now). Will know by 12:30 PT. cc @Li
Marta: SDK PR #412 waiting on final review, failing fmt/lint in js client. I'll fix by lunchtime. The breaking change is an optional header rename -> 'x-rwd-model' -> 'x-rwd-model-id'. Will add compat shim for one release.
Kevin: Eng-infra dependency: proxy header passthrough needs the flag enabled in staging. I filed infra ticket INF-204. Without it canary will 403 on some requests.
Li: Integration tests found an edge where legacy clients send model in body. Added quick decoder fallback in tests. Pushed a test-only patch.
ProductOps: Reminder: customers with dedicated clusters get notified automatically, public API docs need a changelog entry. Drafted message, need approval.
Marta: SDK note — will add feature flag: {
  "enableHeaderRename": false
}
We'll default false in 0.19.1 and flip in 0.20.0 per rollout plan.
Santiago: Canary plan: 5% traffic in us-west for 6h -> 20% next 24h -> full if no regressions. Telemetry hooks added (latency + error-rate).
Kevin: infra says proxy flip scheduled 2026-03-20T02:00Z (staging). I'll coordinate.
Marta: pinging reviewers @kevin @Li for SDK PR review (already addressed comments).
Li: Quick note: I saw a timeout increase on batch endpoints during perf run, might be batching threshold needing tweak. Investigating.
devops-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary schema-rollout v2 -> staging at 2026-03-20T03:00Z by @Santiago. CI: runtime passing, sdk lint failing.
Santiago: Will monitor canary dashboard and set alert if error-rate > 0.5% or latency p95 > 400ms.
Jamie: Thanks — plan sounds good. Blocking list: infra proxy flag (INF-204), SDK lint (Marta fix), batching timeout (Li). If those are cleared, we proceed with canary. Please update this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
